about.title: Clean, friendly, and relaxing.
body: Napa Valley Nails Salon is a full-service nail salon at 706 Trancas Street in Napa, doing manicures, pedicures, gel, dip powder, acrylics, extensions and nail art for both women and men.

Reviewers describe the salon as clean and hygienic with a huge variety of colors, and they keep coming back for relaxing pedicures, foot massages and thin, natural-looking acrylics. Regulars mention techs by name, including Ann, Lee, Joe, Kenny, Kevin and Kim.

reviews.text: Love 💕 this nail salon. The team does a great job (just what I ask for) and are welcoming and can almost always fit me in at the last minute. Thank you Ann for years of service and friendship.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: The nail salon employees here are very nice, and take good care of your nails. They give great massages and are hygienic.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: My wife and I both got a nice relaxing pedicure on vacation! I mean, when she uses that buffer kind of roughly, I'm crawling up the back of the chair... But my feet feel so nice now! The foot massage was wonderful. Thank you!
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: Lee did an exceptional service, my feet are so clean, relaxed and painted! I’m so excited they look great! I’m falling asleep being so comfortable and relaxed I couldn’t help it!! I’m coming back for more !!!
reviews.author: BestProsInTown reviewer

reviews.text: They did a wonderful job, charge very reasonably, and do a great acrylics.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: Ann did my pedicure and my manicure! Not only did she do such a stunning job, she was so sweet and kind. I really enjoyed our time together and our little chats :) she’s an absolute doll and truly made my nail appointment an experience. Please please please go here and ask for her if she’s in! Calling ahead is a good idea to make sure she can take you. Thank you, Ann!
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: I have finally made Napa Valley Nails my place !! My experience has always been pleasurable. Anna is so sweet and does an amazing and detailed job.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: I just went to this shop yesterday and will definitely be coming back! This place is so clean and carries a huge variety of colors to choose from. My nail tech Anna did an amazing job. She was very kind and pleasant to me. I absolutely love it here and will come back very soon.

Manicures, pedicures, gel nails, dip powder, acrylics, gel and regular nail extensions, nail art and polish, plus men's manicures and pedicures. Waxing and skin care are also listed.
Monday–Friday 9:30 AM–6:30 PM, Saturday 9:30 AM–6 PM. Closed Sunday.
706 Trancas St, Suite A, Napa, CA 94558, with private lot parking.
